facts.purpose: the organisation the team's repos live in

facts.verify: each slug appears in a CODEOWNERS file of a team repo (`gh api repos/<o>/<r>/contents/.github/CODEOWNERS`)
facts.purpose: the user's teams that CODEOWNERS may request

facts.verify: a login ending in [bot] (or the org's review app) requested on most PRs; none → leave empty
facts.purpose: the bot whose review is the pr-watch verdict

facts.verify: > 0 on the team's main repos → true; also true when a push was rejected for an unsigned commit
facts.purpose: whether commits go through the sign-queue

facts.verify: the account exists and is a member of the org (`gh api orgs/{config.github.org}/members/{name}` → 204)
the team exists and has write on the repos it owns (`codeowners/errors` on the repo is empty)
the list is non-empty; the row handle is <owner/repo>
facts.purpose: labels a repo actually has (pr-open's type/area mapping)

facts.verify: every login with a github.person row appears as login → first name (`kit_profile.py`'s github command builds the map from the rows)
facts.purpose: login → first name map pr-scan renders in its queue table

facts.verify: `NAME=value` where a sandbox proxy needs a placeholder token for `gh`; empty on a host where `gh` is natively logged in (kit-health warns when a sandbox is detected and this is still empty)
facts.purpose: the placeholder every gh-invoking script applies before calling `gh`
